name: OcclBench
description: Text-to-image models often struggle to synthesize correct occlusion relationships among multiple objects, especially in densely overlapping regions. Many training-free layout-guided methods enforce 2D spatial constraints but do not explicitly resolve depth-dependent attention competition, which can cause concept mixing and implausible occlusion. To address this problem, we propose DepthArb, a training-free framework that formulates occlusion generation as attention arbitration within a unified denoising trajectory.
